directRate.title: Found us on a booking site?

directRate.terms: For the same dates, guests and cancellation terms. Subject to verification and availability.

bestRate.title: Best price guaranteed
bestRate.description: Show us the price you found online and book the same stay directly with an extra 15% discount.
bestRate.terms: Same dates, guests and cancellation terms. Verification and availability required.

about.title: About us
about.description: Villa Venere is a beautiful sea-view villa near the beaches and center of Cetara. It offers three bedrooms, two bathrooms, a comfortable living room, an equipped induction kitchen and a panoramic terrace overlooking the Tower and Port. The villa also has private access to the sea.
